repairs.quote: Wukong gains 20% Move Speed and spins his staff, Knocking Up nearby enemies for 0.6 seconds and take (275% Attack Damage) plus 8/12/16% max Health physical damage over 2 seconds. This Ability can be cast a second time within 8 seconds before going on cooldown. Damage to jungle monsters is capped at (400 ~ 1200) damage over 2 seconds.
